description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4928003290), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11589470), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/666ho), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/room666), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000065424), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=240944)

A prostitute who sells his body while in debt, 'Lee Tae-hyun'. When he finds out that his only beloved colleague, 'Choi Woo-yeon', was assaulted by a customer, he goes to room 666 of Gwisan Villa to get revenge. However, what was waiting for him in room 666 was not a customer, but 'Jeong-woo', the only son of a gangster family who runs a drug company. Jeong-woo, who kills a person and gets high on drugs, mistakes Tae-hyun for someone else and carries out his own revenge... The story of Tae-hyun, who sells his body but is pure at heart, and the rogue drug dealer Jeong-woo becoming close physically.
